found.name: Student Academic Integrity Mandatory Training
found.quote: Each year, you are required to complete the Student Academic Integrity Mandatory Training as part of the UniSQ Student Academic Misconduct Procedure.
You must still acknowledge AI according to academic integrity practices. Failure to reference AI correctly can result in academic misconduct penalties. For guidance, see our UniSQ library guidelines.

found.name: Librarians
found.quote: If you're not sure, you can reach out to our friendly Librarians to talk through this one-on-one.

found.name: AI in Assessment
found.quote: Learn more about AI in Assessment and what it means for your studies at UniSQ.
